title: Functorial injective embeddings in a Grothendieck abelian category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Then $\mathcal A$ has functorial injective embeddings: there are a functor $J:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ and a natural transformation $j:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal A}\to J$ such that for every object $A$ the morphism $j_A:A\to J(A)$ is a monomorphism and $J(A)$ is an injective object of $\mathcal A$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. In particular, for every small category $\mathcal I$ and every diagram $i\mapsto A_i$, $\mathcal I\to\mathcal A$, the maps $j_{A_i}:A_i\to J(A_i)$ form a morphism of diagrams from $(A_i)$ to the diagram $(J(A_i))$ of injective objects, each component a monomorphism.
